summary: Feed c055_broker to APM is degraded: 66.61% packet loss from egress congestion on VF-1 port 1/5. Tool port saturated at 100% of 10 Gbps (bursts higher) discarding 213,782,100 packets, APM missing majority of traffic.

findings.root_cause: VF-1 egress port 1/5 to APM is oversubscribed. Average load is 100% of the 10 Gbps tool port with bursts above line rate, causing output queue tail drops (213,782,100 discards, 66.61% loss). Aggregate traffic steered to the APM exceeds single 10G port capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM loses ~2/3 of packets/flows in both directions. Transaction metrics, latency/error rates and dependency maps are incomplete and inaccurate, bursts missed entirely, severely reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute >10G aggregate across multiple 10G APM members (or upgrade tool port to 25/40G) to eliminate egress drops with 5-tuple hashing to keep both directions together. Since APM needs_full_payload=false, slicing to ~512B or filtering irrelevant traffic are lower-cost alternatives to bring load below 10G while preserving headers APM needs.
